ideas.pitch: A local log-analysis agent built with the Vercel AI SDK and strict prompt-injection hardening that parses system logs for unusual privilege escalation attempts and visualizes security anomalies.
ideas.title: AnomalyGuard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly matches the winning formula of defense-in-depth personal agent tooling while staying perfectly aligned with SECURA's focus on detecting and analysing cybersecurity anomalies.

ideas.pitch: A rapid-deployment FastAPI and React application that uses a lightweight fine-tuned BERT model to evaluate incoming phishing links, suspicious SMS payloads, and malicious email headers in real time.
ideas.title: PhishBERT
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates a proven runner-up strategy at cybersecurity hackathons by delivering an immediately practical, high-utility defensive tool against common cyber threats.

ideas.pitch: An automated security insight generator that scans local repository codebases for hardcoded secrets, misconfigured dependencies, and common vulnerability patterns before producing a clean audit report.
ideas.title: RepoSentinel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs the same automated documentation and security insight generation approach that took first place at Microsoft's global intern hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight transaction graph analysis dashboard designed to spot suspicious wallet clustering and high-risk transactional nodes using heuristic graph intelligence.
ideas.title: GraphAML-Lite
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts complex graph intelligence and risk detection architectures into a tightly scoped, highly visual prototype suitable for a 24 to 48 hour timeframe.

ideas.pitch: A localized deterministic rule-engine and engagement gate that intercepts unverified network packets at the edge and enforces strict human-in-the-loop validation for suspicious commands.
ideas.title: EdgeGate Defense
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning edge-defense and deterministic engagement gate architecture seen at top government and defense hackathons.
